book.name: Luka
book.title: Luka Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Lukaꞌa Mirihiro

content: Uti Vazeḡa Boroꞌa Iesu mazao Firo
Iesuꞌa ane ḡoere niduꞌa zeḡe mazao ḡoeriroteꞌe enogano, Kaperanauma diuḡiro.
Eꞌea uti vazeḡa boro ꞌahoganiꞌa radiunu. Aneꞌa zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe tuḡureḡa vazeḡaꞌe ugine sausaunadu nariga rudaro.
Uti vazeḡa boroꞌe Iesu hariḡa igirotene, Iesuꞌa aradu ani tuḡure vazeḡa fainoga uratiro. Eꞌanoꞌo ani Iuda azaḡa boroboro Iesu uminoga veize tuḡuziro.
Ebu zeꞌe Iesu mazao feuradu zamaze niduꞌa hina uminiro, “Ḡa ani dananine manoḡa,
mazaḡa aniꞌe eme, Iuda azaḡa zamare borofeꞌohe ebu emeḡe veize nu'onu'o neḡa ogoraro.”

Eꞌanoꞌo Iesuꞌa zeḡe teite uti vazeḡa boro ne onamiro. Ze uti vazeḡa boro ne uhiḡano feurirotene, uti vazeḡa boroꞌa ane vaze nu Iesu vaḡe tuḡuziro. Ebu zeꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu niro, “Uti vazeḡa boroꞌa ꞌahige rae raha, 'Zuhiꞌa Boro, ago ufeta zamaroꞌi. Eꞌe mene vaze manoḡa ꞌahine, ḡaeꞌa eḡe ne diuḡogaꞌe mene idaḡa.
Eꞌanoꞌo e ḡa vaḡe amiꞌuma rae mene zamareha. Rehano ḡa ḡoere daꞌo roꞌi, ꞌougine eḡe tuḡure vazeḡaniꞌa manoriꞌuma.

Mazaḡa eḡe zuni vaze ꞌahoga ꞌuꞌuḡano gaueꞌohe, ebu uti azaḡa zuni eḡe ꞌuꞌuḡano gaueꞌohe. Eḡeꞌa vaze ꞌahi ninaꞌa, “Onamoꞌi,” raꞌetene aniꞌe onameꞌohe, ebu ꞌahoga ꞌomo ninaꞌa, “Aroꞌi,” raꞌetene aniꞌe areꞌohe. Eḡeꞌa eḡe tuḡure vazeḡa ꞌahoga ninaꞌa, “ꞌAdi haḡaoꞌi,” raꞌetene aniꞌe haḡaeꞌohe.'”
Iesuꞌa ani ḡoere igirotene, ani ḡoere uꞌano zaguzagaro. Ebu vaetadu ane hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Isaraela azaḡa boꞌaḡano ꞌahige fie gigaruꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ꞌize mene horoneha.”
Ebu ze bare uti vazeḡa boro ne onamirotene, tuḡure vazeḡaniꞌa manoriroteꞌe horoniro.
Iesuꞌa Ḡozoba Ubuga Runeonoꞌo Ḡaboniro
Eꞌe enogano, Iesuꞌa ne ꞌahoga niḡa Naina onamiro. Ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa zu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa ani ḡatiniro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ne ḡutuꞌaḡano feurirotene, ne azaḡaꞌe rune vazeḡa ꞌahoga herate buni ariro. Aniꞌe ḡozoba ꞌahoga ubuga tibuhuga. Ebu ne azaḡa ḡehaḡa zuni ḡozoba eꞌe teite ariro.
Iesuꞌa ḡozoba eꞌe horonirotene, ani vetuḡaneadu niro, “Ago nianoꞌi.”
Ebu hena Iesuꞌa rune ahiꞌa mauḡa herateꞌeteꞌe azaḡa vaḡe onamadu mauḡa obonirotene, ze tue edaro. Ebu aniꞌa rune vazeḡa niro, “Tahiꞌa iziga, eḡeꞌa ḡaꞌohe, iḡunoꞌi!”
ꞌOugirotene, rune vazeḡaniꞌa iḡune ehoradu ḡoeꞌa ḡadaheniro, ebu Iesuꞌa bare viꞌa ꞌevoreo riꞌiniro.
ꞌOugadu zeḡe niduꞌa rihau rudaro zu Badiꞌa niguniro. Ze ꞌahige rae reiro, “Peroveta vazeḡa boroꞌa emeḡe boꞌaḡano fureraneha!” ebu “Badiꞌaꞌa ane mone azaḡa danazifine areha!”
Ebu Iesuꞌa nagini haḡairoteꞌe hariḡaniꞌa Iuda habaꞌa ebu uhiḡa habaꞌa niduꞌa zamaḡano bororaro.
Iesu zu Ioane Babatiso
Ioane Babatisoꞌe ḡuꞌa neḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ane vaḡe onamadu Iesuꞌa haḡairoteꞌe hariḡa niduꞌa meꞌodoharo. Ebu Ioaneꞌa ane tahiꞌa aheu huzadu ziro,
“Zuhiꞌa Boro vaḡe onamadu ꞌahige ḡadinoꞌi, 'Ariꞌuma rae reiroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡahe? Mene reine, eme vaze ꞌahoga guhiniꞌumahe?'”
Ebu ze Iesu vaḡe onamadu ḡadiniro, “Ioane Babatisoꞌa ḡadiꞌoga veize eme tuḡufeha. 'Ariꞌuma rae reiroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡahe? Mene reine, eme vaze ꞌahoga guhiniꞌumahe?'”
Eꞌe madaḡano Iesuꞌa ugi nunu zu vine sauꞌa meiroteꞌe azaḡa ḡehaḡa faiziro, ebu ubuma kuruḡa azaḡa ḡehaḡa faizadu ze bare ehamaro.

Eꞌanoꞌo Iesuꞌa Ioane tahiꞌa aheu naenaeziro, “Bare onamadu zaeꞌa nagini horonateꞌe zu egateꞌe Ioane ihonoꞌi. Ubuma kuru azaḡaꞌe ehamuꞌohe, oda sauꞌa azaḡaꞌe edau ragaveꞌohe, refera azaḡaꞌe manoreꞌohe, teḡaze uhuḡa azaḡaꞌe igiꞌohe, rune azaḡaꞌe bare ḡabodeꞌohe, ebu zahara azaḡaꞌe hari manoḡa igiꞌohe.
Eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌe mene modeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe matuꞌiꞌuma.”

Ioaneꞌa tuḡuziroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa iḡuniroteꞌe enogano, Iesuꞌa Ioane moneo vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa ḡadahe ziro, “Za nagini horonoga veize haba bohaꞌa onamiro? Zavaraꞌa imi veḡa hudi naeninaeniꞌeteꞌe horonoga radu onamirohe?
Mene reine, za nagini horonoga veize onamiro? Dabua manomano vidaroteꞌe vazeḡa horonoga veize onamirohe? Naeḡa boro dabuaḡa vidaroteꞌe zu ḡau manomanoḡeta radiuꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe kini neo radiuꞌohe.
ꞌOugadu nagini horonoga veize onamiro? Peroveta vazeḡahe? Oꞌe, eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Ioaneꞌe peroveta azaḡa vitizoga.
Ioane moneo Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro,

content.text: 'Ḡianoꞌi, eḡeꞌa ḡae zamao vaze ꞌahoga ibite tuḡuniꞌuma.
Aniꞌe ḡae zamao ḡae ibi ruhibiꞌuma.'

content: Eꞌanoꞌo eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Ioaneꞌe rahao ꞌada fureraroteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa vitizoga. Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡanoꞌe ḡonaga vazeḡa zuni Ioane vitinoga.”
(Ebu Iesu ḡoere igiroteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa zu takesi azaḡa zuni Ioane mazaonoꞌo babatiso meiro. Ebu zeꞌe ꞌahige rae reiro, “Badiꞌa gau ibiḡaꞌe duduḡa!”
U Farisea azaḡa zu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Ioane mazaonoꞌo babatiso mene meiro. ꞌOugadu ze zeḡe veize Badiꞌaꞌa haḡaiteꞌe haḡaiḡa hezahoharo.)
Iesuꞌa bare ziro, “Izidi azaḡaꞌe naginio idaziꞌuma? Ze iniu heuḡa?
Zeꞌe tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌaniꞌa ne hunio ehoradu araheꞌeteꞌe heuḡa. Ze rovozadu none tahiꞌaḡaniꞌa mone tahiꞌaḡa mazao ꞌahige huauꞌohe,

content.text: 'Eme muio suraꞌi hodeha, rehano za mene zavoneha.
Ebu eme rune habaꞌano niau ḡoinaheha, rehano za mene nianeha.'

content: Ioane babatisoꞌa aradu ogomu mene audo zu vaini vuḡa mene gagido. ꞌOugadu za ꞌahige rae reiro, 'Ioaneꞌe vine sauꞌaḡeta.'

U Vaze Ubugaꞌe aradu ogomu auꞌohe ebu vaini vuḡa gageꞌohe. ꞌOugeꞌetene, za bare ꞌahige raꞌohe, 'Ḡianoꞌi, aniꞌe ogomu fuꞌa zu vaini vuḡa fuꞌa. Ebu ani takesi azaḡa zu haḡai sauꞌa azaḡa teite tiburuꞌohe.'
Rehano Badiꞌa zamarone huhuzaḡa hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ane zamarone huhuzaḡaꞌe duduḡa rae fureneꞌohe.”
Haḡai Sauꞌa Roḡaeḡaniꞌa Iesu Odaḡa rana Dehoro Beꞌuniro
Mada ꞌahogano Farisea vazeḡa ꞌahoga, Simonaꞌa Iesu teite oganoga veize Iesu huniro. Ebu Iesuꞌa Farisea vazeḡa ne onamadu ogomu fataḡa babaḡano tave ehoriro.
Eꞌe neḡanoꞌe haḡai sauꞌa roḡaeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa radiunu. Aniꞌe Iesuꞌa Farisea vazeḡa neo ogauꞌeteꞌe ederirotene, dehoro hohoga manoḡa naeḡa boro bio komeꞌa manohuga iriꞌavonadu mae ariro.

Ebu roḡae eꞌeꞌa ne diuḡadu Iesu ḡarugano niauꞌenaꞌa, odaḡa babaḡano ḡuḡuriro. Ebu niḡa vuḡaniꞌa Iesu oda rana sore buanadu abune vanirotene, iguḡa hina odaḡa zauhiro. Ebu gubaneꞌenaꞌa, odaḡa furaꞌinadu dehoro beuꞌiro.

Iesu huniroteꞌe Farisea vazeḡa Simonaꞌa eꞌe horonirotene, ani aneꞌa bare ꞌahige rae reiro, “Vaze ꞌadiꞌe peroveta vazeḡa reifone, ani oboneꞌeteꞌe roḡaeḡaꞌe roḡae nagiga rae ederifo. Roḡae ꞌahiꞌe haḡai sauꞌa roḡaeḡa rae ederifo.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Simona, e hari ꞌahoga ḡeꞌuma.” Simonaꞌa naenaeniro, “Ihore vazeḡa, ehoꞌi.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa hari ꞌahoga meꞌodoharo, “Vaze aheuꞌa vaze ꞌahoga mazaonoꞌo hadi nu madu vesu baroniꞌuma rae reiro. ꞌAhogaꞌe hadi silivaḡa
niduꞌa 500 meiro, u ꞌahogaꞌe hadi silivaḡa niduꞌa 50 meiro.
Ebu vaze aheuꞌe hadi vazeḡa mazao hadi baronoga mene idararo, eꞌanoꞌo hadi vazeḡaniꞌa ziro, 'Ahiḡa, ago baronoꞌi.' ꞌOugine, anianine boꞌaḡano iniuꞌa hadi vazeḡa ufeta zamare borofiꞌuma?”

Simonaꞌa naenaeniro, “E zamarone, hadi silivaḡa 500 meiroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa hadi vazeḡa ufeta zamare borofiꞌuma. Mazaḡa hadi vazeḡaniꞌa ane hadi boro ago baronoꞌi rae reiro.” Ebu Iesuꞌa niro, “Ḡae naenaeꞌe duduḡa.”

Ebu Iesuꞌa roḡae tehe ḡianadu Simona niro, “Ḡa roḡae ꞌadi horoneꞌehe? E ḡae ne diuḡatene, ḡaꞌe odahe vuzuꞌoga veize vu mene eneha. Rehano roḡae ꞌahiꞌe eḡe oda ani ni vuḡa hina abunadu iguḡa hina zauhe imineha.
Ḡaꞌe mene gubahe furaꞌiheha, rehano roḡae ꞌahiꞌe eḡeꞌa diuḡi arateꞌeanoꞌo odahe ꞌauꞌaune furaꞌineha.
Ḡaꞌe vadiniheo dehoro mene beuꞌeha, rehano aniꞌe eḡe odao dehoro hohoḡa manoḡa beuꞌeha.

Eꞌanoꞌo eḡeꞌa ḡaꞌohe, roḡae ꞌahi haḡaiḡa sauꞌa ḡehaḡa ꞌai rae modeha, mazaḡa ani eḡe zamare borofadu eḡe mazao ꞌouge haḡaeha. U eḡeꞌa iniu haḡaiḡa sauꞌa tahiḡa daꞌo rae modine, aniꞌa eḡe tahiḡa daꞌo zamariꞌuma.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa roḡae eꞌe niro, “Ḡae haḡai sauꞌa ꞌai rae modeha.”
ꞌOugirotene, Iesu teite ogauꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe zeḡeꞌa bare zamariro, “ꞌAhiꞌe iniu? Ani vaze haḡai sauꞌa zuni rae modeꞌehe?”
Ebu Iesuꞌa roḡae eꞌe niro, “Ḡaeꞌa eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano ḡabone hideha. Zamaḡo roḡenadu onamoꞌi.”
